name: Emergency Notification
description: Adds site-wide emergency notification functionality (alert banner).
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 Provides the ability to display a customizable emergency notification on all pages, exempt the pages that are being excluded in the configuration. Once the is dismissed the emergency notification is still accessible through a button that is fixed to the bottom of the page.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information. 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Navigate to Configuration > System > Emergency Notification settings.

 
 Configure settings, check "Emergency notification enabled" and save. 
 Done!!! An emergency notification will now be visible on your site.
